title: The Genealogy and Birth of Jesus Christ

questions.question: How does Matthew begin the genealogy of Jesus Christ?
options: "The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham."
"The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz..."
"In the days of Herod, king of Judea..."
questions.correctAnswer: "The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham."
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:1 (ESV): "The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham."

questions.question: Which of these women is explicitly named in the genealogy of Jesus in chapter 1?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:5 (ESV): "and Salmon the father of Boaz by Rahab, and Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, and Obed the father of Jesse,"

questions.question: Who is listed as the mother of Perez and Zerah?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:3 (ESV): "and Judah the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar..."

questions.question: How is Solomon's mother referred to in the genealogy?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:6 (ESV): "and David was the father of Solomon by the wife of Uriah,"

questions.question: Who was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:16 (ESV): "and Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called Christ." (Note: Luke's genealogy says Heli).

questions.question: According to Matthew 1:17, how many generations were there from Abraham to David?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:17 (ESV): "So all the generations from Abraham to David were fourteen generations..."

questions.question: Before Joseph and Mary came together, Mary was found to be with child from whom?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:18 (ESV): "When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found to be with child from the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: Because Joseph was a just man and unwilling to put Mary to shame, what did he resolve to do?
options: Have her stoned according to the Law
Flee to Egypt with her immediately
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:19 (ESV): "And her husband Joseph, being a just man and unwilling to put her to shame, resolved to divorce her quietly."

questions.question: How did the angel of the Lord appear to Joseph to instruct him not to fear taking Mary as his wife?
options: As a traveler at his door
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:20 (ESV): "But as he considered these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream..."

questions.question: The angel tells Joseph to call the child's name Jesus, because He will do what?
options: He will save his people from their sins
He will conquer the Roman empire
He will rebuild the temple in Jerusalem
He will bring peace to all nations immediately
questions.correctAnswer: He will save his people from their sins
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:21 (ESV): "She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."

questions.question: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet: "Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall call his name Immanuel." What does Immanuel mean?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:23 (ESV): "...and they shall call his name Immanuel (which means, God with us).

questions.question: Which Old Testament prophet originally spoke the prophecy "Behold, the virgin shall conceive..."?
When Joseph woke from sleep, did he do as the angel commanded?
options: Yes, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him: he took his wife
No, he waited for another sign
He asked the priests for advice first
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him: he took his wife
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:24 (ESV): "When Joseph woke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him: he took his wife,"

questions.question: What is explicitly stated about Joseph's marital relations with Mary until she had given birth to a son?
options: He knew her not until she had given birth to a son
They lived as brother and sister for three years
He left her with her parents until the birth
He celebrated the marriage feast for seven days
questions.correctAnswer: He knew her not until she had given birth to a son
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:25 (ESV): "but knew her not until she had given birth to a son. And he called his name Jesus."

questions.question: Who gave the child the name "Jesus" when He was born?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:25 (ESV): "but knew her not until she had given birth to a son. And he called his name Jesus." (Comparing v. 21 where the angel instructs Joseph "you shall call his name Jesus").

key_verse_text: "She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins."
